title: aspidium filix-mas var. lacerum
intro: Aspidium filix-mas var. lacerum, commonly known as the Lacerate Lady Fern, is a variety of fern that belongs to the family Woodwardia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Aspidium filix-mas var. lacerum include demulcent, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it an effective treatment for skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and provide relief from various health conditions.
